description: This PHP class 'SaveJobTitleController' is part of the OrangeHRM project, residing in the admin plugin's controller directory. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the pre-rendering setup for the job title save/edit UI component, determining which component to instantiate based on request attributes and adding configuration properties such as allowed file types and max attachment size.

classes.name: SaveJobTitleController
classes.description: Controller that manages the pre-render logic for the save/edit job title component, dynamically selecting and configuring the component based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by selecting the appropriate component ('job-title-edit' or 'job-title-save') and setting properties such as allowed file types and maximum file size for attachments.
